hypothesis: The kernel-sync decompose's C1 candidate - a freshness memo skipping the redundant kernel re-dump while the namespace provably cannot have changed - cuts the recurring capture-entry walls (the compact-time S2a prune and the dispose S3 flush measured at 509ms/530ms of the O8m compact/exit walls) WITHOUT touching the cross-product payload format: the memo is manager-side (the settled-user-execution + committed-manifest-stat witness the product already ships for the post-restore fire, generalized to every capture), so the dump format needs NO version bump and both readers are untouched. The decompose's per-variable headline (re-dump only changed names) is UNSOUND in Python and is closed as an honest negative.
approach: PAIRED same-VM sequential ABBA on VM e0427kpil34dpotc47emtz30 (fresh, ubuntu:22.04 16c/32GB/100GB, rustup 1.98.1): base = the tip head 78f257bf0 (binary sha 22b4298c80a41aa2216149b3bc4fcc549ed48c8d0d6bfbe2e19bdac493973982) vs candidate = the lane merge e6e4ef964 (binary sha e135e88202aba53ffa7eb15f45d468e4a58b85a1b6abbd77791f9ebef28958d9; the lane commit f3b121570 + the fold); the lane's post-run fold to 910ccc18e (tip 4c40e964b) verified re-diff byte-identical. Sha-asserted unlink-then-copy binary swaps with X_OK asserts; the driver asserts base!=cand before arming (the identical-pair trap: a same-VM checkout->cargo build once produced a byte-identical pair - cargo skipped the pa-core recompile across the checkout; remedy = clean the changed crates + assert). Classes E/B64k/B1m/B8m/B32m/O8m/OCAP, n=12/arm/class over ascending+descending passes (arms b,c,c,b asc / c,b,b,c desc, 3 trials/slot), the kernelsync trial shape (build/control/big/interference turns -> compact -> get_state -> stdin-close exit) over the RPC surface with the offline mock + PA_COMPACTION_TRACE spans + the artifact commit watcher + payload/manifest sha + notice-row extraction; plus the stock-10MiB settle-frame phase (E/B8m/O8m, n=6/arm/class) for Kevin's Enter-to-reply marker. parity_notes: (1) TS-PARITY CASE CLOSED: TS has NO recurring freshness mechanism - repl-manager.ts:1713-1723 schedules the debounced capture unconditionally; only the one-shot post-restore skip exists on both sides (consumeRestoredSnapshotSkip :1727-1741, the completedExecutions+manifest-stat witness). TS's vendored runtime has no per-var skip either (diffed: the rust runtime is the hardened superset). The memo is the same internal-divergence class as the shipped rust-only restore_boot_hold, byte-preserving on every observable surface. (2) THE C1 PER-VARIABLE HEADLINE IS CLOSED UNSOUND: the O8m cost class is mutable nested trees - in-place mutation (tree['k']=v) is invisible to every cheap witness (id/type/len/dirty-dict; the shipped writer already re-measures for exactly this class, repl.py's prune path: 'in-place mutation defeats any name-based size tracking'); the string classes pickle at ~0.9ms/MiB and every SOUND content witness (memcmp vs resident committed bytes / re-read+compare) costs ~the pickle itself; id-only witnesses are unsound (del x; x=<new same-address str>); so 're-dump only changed names' cannot be delivered soundly at the class that carries the cost - the served-path oracle (a changed var MUST re-dump) fails by construction. (3) NO VERSION BUMP NEEDED: the memo never alters on-disk bytes (the skip means the committed payload stands); both readers untouched - proven by the both-readers round-trip oracle 6/6 PASS on the VM (rust-writer->ts-reader, ts-writer->rust-reader, the v1 legacy dict, the per-variable cap; the lane runtime + the TS checkout's runtime, kernel-venv dill 0.4.1). (4) THE LISTING DEFEAT (found by the pre-measurement smoke): the compact's own list_names request settles like a cell and was bumping the witness count - every compact would have defeated the dispose skip. FIX: the witness counts USER settles only (the new user_executions counter, bumped only for !internal requests; internal state ops - the listing, the captures, the repair bootstrap - never move it; the normal boot's bootstrap IS a real execute and still counts). Pinned by the in-repo oracle an_internal_state_request_does_not_defeat_the_fresh_skip. Smoke proof pre/post the fix: the O8m exit 615->63.6ms.

measurements.headline: The recurring capture-freshness memo skips the redundant kernel re-dump at every fresh-window capture: the S2a prune span 537->0.1ms at O8m (the over-cap survivor arm OCAP is the honest control: 5.60->5.49, NOT skipped, the #227 prune still runs and discloses), the compact wall O8m 763->99ms (-664ms, -87%) and B32m 245->109 (-136ms), the dispose exit wall O8m 615->64ms (-551ms) and B8m/B32m -32ms, the commit census 6->4 per trial (E: 3->1). THE S2c WRITEBACK-INTERPLAY DIVIDEND (regime-bound, CLASS=D, disclosed as such): with no fresh payload writeback the notice tail rides the fast path - S2c 72-98ms -> 0.5-0.7ms at every skipped class (the compact wall halves at the small classes too: E 157->82, B64k 159->80, B1m 162->90); the OCAP control shows S2c unchanged (84.7->81.6) - the memo touches nothing when it does not skip. HONEST NEGATIVES: the O8m next-cell interference is UNMOVED (the tD cell waits the S1 post-cell fire's dump: 424->435ms p50, in-window 18/18 both arms - the per-var memo is unsound, so the fire still dumps; C3 chunking remains the open candidate for that class); the Enter-to-reply turn wall is unchanged at every class (b~c within pass noise) and at the stock-10MiB settle frame (E 55.5/64.5 n=6, B8m 158/151, O8m 227.5/208.5 p50 with the p90 tail 648/642 unmoved - the interference tail).

MARGIN ASSESSMENT vs the best-in-class in this dimension (kernel-persistent agents, the TS product itself included, provenance: the kernel-sync decompose record 20260928-190500 + this lane's base arm): every kernel-persistent product measured pays the unconditional compact-time re-dump (TS prunes unconditionally, agent-session.ts:8604-8606); the memo takes the kernel-sync component of the compact wall to ~0 (0.1ms) at the fresh window - a >1000x reduction of that component vs the best measured unconditional behavior, while KEEPING the persistence semantics (the notice bytes, the payload, the crash-resume contract all byte-preserved). The remaining gap to a hypothetical zero-sync compact is the S2b listing (~0.35ms) - immaterial. The remaining kernel-sync cost on the settle path is the S1 post-cell fire (the O8m p90 tail ~600ms) - NOT addressed by this lane (C3).
